allow_instructions: Read-only git inspection, TypeScript check, lint, and the fixed TSB scripts under scripts/ are fine without asking.
block_instructions: Block git push, commit, add, pull, merge, rebase, reset, checkout, and clean.
Block TSB import or meta regeneration: npm run tsb:import-*, tsb:meta, tsb:split-*, tsb:export-*.
Block budget private data, .env files, deploy commands, file deletion, and paths outside the workspace.
Block arbitrary node -e one-liners and npm run build unless the user explicitly asked for a build this turn.
